content: इड् {%f.%} (also written इल् in Veda)¦ [इल्-क्विप् वा लस्य डः] .²1 An offering or oblation, libation offered to the gods. .²2 Prayer, flow of speech. .²3 The earth. .²4 Food. .²5 The rainy season. .²6 The third of the five {%prayājas%} (इडो यजति). .²7 People or subjects. (<ab>pl.</ab>) The object of devotion.
